description: Installations de géothermie de surface sur sondes et sur nappes en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BRGM. Ces données sont issues du BRGM. "L’inventaire de ces installations, adossé à la Banque de données du Sous-Sol (BSS), est alimenté en continu par le déversement des nouvelles opérations en provenance du portail de télé-déclarations, depuis l'arrêté du 25 juin 2015 relatif à la Géothermie de Minime Importance. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Installations EnR, Géothermie, Sonde, Nappe, TEO, Energie. The portal shows 8,818 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
